evidence_observations.indicator_description: Two chronological claim notes state different incident dates; the discrepancy is documented but not resolved.
The vehicle description in the intake note is incomplete relative to the policy vehicle fields.
The photograph summary and estimate describe different damaged vehicle areas.

The closure note refers to an amount that is not supported by a separate physical claim document.
